style: Refined flat vector illustration in dark moss green (#232a22), champagne gold (#e6c79c) and cream, elegant clean lines, small electrical spark accents, no text.

subjects.electricite-auto: A car battery, an alternator and a starter motor on a workbench with a digital multimeter connected by red and black leads.

hero: A refined repair workshop interior: a car on a lift with its hood open, a multimeter and diagnostic cart with wires beside it, a tidy tool wall, warm champagne-coloured lamps. Flat vector, DARK moss green overall, champagne-gold highlights, cream accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame).
